agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technology significance and bounded application implications

analytical_question: Does generative AI's broader significance justify launching unreviewed personalized investment recommendations at this hypothetical bank within six months?
general_et_finding: The general classification remains Potential Promethean, qualified, in prospective mode. The system under analysis is deployed general-purpose generative AI, not the proposed bank channel. Before this system, flexible language responses generally required fresh human formulation; removing the need to compose each response is a credible emerging barrier-removal mechanism, although earlier automation existed and human verification persists. E2-E4 support meaningful capability change. They do not prove that suppressing the technology class would collapse essential societal systems rather than restore manual work. Economic work and cognitive/social learning provide two possible tiers; biological-survival dissolution is not established. Under E1, this is a prospective candidate with demonstrated breakthrough capabilities, not retrospective confirmation. Six criteria: order-of-magnitude NOT DEMONSTRATED (no defined 10x result in E2-E3); widespread impact PARTIAL (E2-E4 span work and education); paradigm shift PARTIAL (separating composition from human response formulation is an inference from E2-E4); catalytic effect PARTIAL (E4 is a secondary application, not a demonstrated dependent innovation wave); democratizing effect NOT ESTABLISHED (direct access-distribution evidence is missing); irreversibility UNRESOLVED (no durable cross-tier dependency evidence). The ratings cannot substitute for a passed dissolution gate. Aggressive bank posture supplies no additional general technology evidence and cannot upgrade this to Confirmed Promethean.
application_finding: The application would transfer consequential communication and judgment from human-reviewed research to autonomous client delivery. That is a potentially major organizational change, not simply faster drafting. Its expected reliability and value are unproven. The client channel's possible importance is separate from both the broad technology label and authorization to launch.
organization_specific_finding: This aggressive bank has no task-specific validation or demonstrated client-protection controls in the intake. An approved workspace alone does not address incorrect recommendations or harmful reliance. Unreviewed client harm is harder to reverse than a draft-summary error, so the proposed six-month launch is not justified by the supplied evidence.

evidence.claim: E1 distinguishes prospective potential from confirmed permanence.
evidence.source_or_reference: Fortino, Chapter 11, August 2026 draft Rev 0.1, sections 11.2 and 11.7, pp. 3-4 and 8-11; supplied PDF.
evidence.notes: Does not authorize any specific deployment.
Full-page access blocked; no autonomous-advice evaluation.

evidence.notes: Supports caution about extrapolating across tasks; not a measured client-advice loss rate.

evidence.claim: E4 adds educational capability evidence beyond economic work.

evidence.notes: Publisher access failed; educational results do not validate financial judgments.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The general literature supplies no local autonomous-advice validation.
Fluent outputs may conceal errors; E3 contradicts any assumption of uniform task competence.
Cross-tier dependence, universal 10x gains and expanded access remain unverified.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in qualified Potential Promethean status; low confidence in eventual permanence. There is sufficient case information to recommend deferral, but insufficient evidence to certify a safe launch. Actual model performance, oversight design and client safeguards are missing. No current financial law is interpreted here.
value_opportunity_implication: Expanded coverage is a hypothetical opportunity. It cannot be treated as realized value before validating correctness, review costs and harmful outcomes on the actual task.
risk_governance_implication: Retain accountable human approval. This specialist supplies a significance judgment and a bounded deferral recommendation; financial suitability, safety and compliance require separate qualified review.
recommendation_management_implication: Do not launch unreviewed client recommendations on the current evidence. If further learning is authorized, use an offline sandbox with synthetic client cases and no client delivery. Proposed evaluation: qualified reviewers compare generated outputs with a human-reviewed baseline on the same predefined cases, recording consequential errors, unsupported rationale, reviewer corrections and staff time. Passing this sandbox would not itself authorize autonomy. Require independent task-specific validation and accountable governance before a separate launch decision; no universal safe-error threshold can responsibly be set from these sources.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reconsider the local decision only when task-specific validation and accountable safeguards exist, rather than when executives become more enthusiastic.
Reconsider the broad classification on replicated categorical change, defined 10x evidence and durable multi-tier dependence, or strong contrary evidence.
Review broad significance annually during the three-year horizon.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Withhold certification of autonomous advice, suitability and compliance.
Require actual model/task evidence, accountable reviewer roles and demonstrated client-protection controls.
Withhold Confirmed Promethean until irreversible cross-tier dependence is credibly established.
